You're a member of both #central-team and #inc-tansley-carrier-api, so I can read both for the digest. Once the scheduler works, I'd post the digest each weekday at 08:30. It would list open items from both channels since the previous digest. I'd start from tomorrow, Thu 15 Oct.

Until then, you can @ me any morning and I'll post the digest by hand. Tell me once the scheduler is fixed and I'll set the job up.
